_label: G024+G025 / S009. Odyssey III attacks the OPTIMISED NX, then the honest disposition.
_evidence: MEASURED on CPU against the packed artifact, not the original model.
patient: Qwen3-0.6B via qwen3_06b.nx (6-bit grouped affine, complete EBPW 6.501)

1_probe_sensitivity.why: every number in this campaign rested on ONE eval probe. If quality swings by text, the headline was an artifact of my choice of bytes.
1_probe_sensitivity.honest_reading: top-1 holds between 0.8903 and 0.9426 across four genuinely different domains (manifesto prose + code, pure English, pure Python, structured JSON) -- a spread of 0.052. The headline 0.9393 is representative, not cherry-picked. Worth naming: the WEAKEST domains are structured JSON (0.8903) and pure Python (0.8982), so this codec costs slightly more on code and structured data than on prose -- which matters, because code is HCLI's own domain.

2_payload_corruption.why: the strongest possible test for a hidden dense parent. If something other than the packed codes were supplying weights, corrupting the codes would not matter.
2_payload_corruption.honest_reading: flipping 20,000 payload bytes takes perplexity to 4.85e8 and top-1 agreement to 0.000. The codes are load-bearing and nothing else is supplying the weights. Combined with the parent being renamed away during execution, the no-dense-fallback claim now has two independent mechanical proofs rather than an assurance.

3_replay_determinism.why: a representation that does not reproduce is not a representation.
3_replay_determinism.honest_reading: two independent builds of the model from the same NX produce BIT-IDENTICAL logits.

4_magnitude_control_on_the_nx_path.why: the verifier's adequacy was established against the parent. It must hold on the NX path too, or the NX numbers are ungated.
4_magnitude_control_on_the_nx_path.honest_reading: 0.01xW applied after loading from the NX gives perplexity 151942 and top-1 0.000 -- the gate rejects a destroyed NX exactly as it rejects a destroyed parent.

ATTACKS_NOT_RUN: generation quality (all metrics here are teacher-forced next-token; a real generation eval could differ and was not run)
long-context behaviour -- every probe was <=512 tokens against a 32768-token body
alternate corruption patterns (only one seed and one uniform byte-flip pattern was tried)
a stronger independent oracle -- the fp32 parent is the only reference used

DISPOSITION.verdict: RESEARCH SPECIMEN / REPRESENTATION RESEARCH. Not a Pareto candidate and not a Resident.
DISPOSITION.why: the full chain succeeded MECHANICALLY -- a self-contained NX that runs with its parent renamed away, reproduces bit-identically, survives four attacks, and cuts the shipped bf16 checkpoint 3.10x at top-1 0.94. But it does NOT reach the Gravity ladder: 6.501 complete EBPW against a <2.5 entry rung. The honest summary is that the PIPELINE is proven end to end and this PATIENT is not a Gravity win.
DISPOSITION.resident_verdict: NOT A RESIDENT CANDIDATE. Separately from Gravity, this body cannot run HCLI: it is 0.6B, and the campaign's own evidence is that even the 27B struggles to hold the tool-call dialect. The measured degradation is also worst exactly on code and structured data, which is what HCLI's WorkUnits consist of.
DISPOSITION.value_delivered: the pipeline itself, and three MEASURED laws that transfer to every future patient (grouping beats bit-width on outlier bodies; organ sensitivity is not mass and tolerant organs still impose floors; Gravity headroom needs redundancy, so sub-1B dense bodies do not reach the ladder).

NEXT_PATIENT_selected_by_evidence.why: the exact inverse of this one on every axis that mattered here. Its expert organ is 94.95% of mass with 8 of 128 experts firing per token -- the redundancy a 0.6B dense body could not offer, and the condition R-gravity-headroom-needs-redundancy says is required. The search design is already written (receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_GRAVITY_SEARCH_DESIGN_Qwen3Coder30B.json) with the EBPW arithmetic worked out and the trap named: pushing only the experts leaves 2.71 EBPW because the 5% non-expert remainder costs ~0.8 EBPW at BF16.
NEXT_PATIENT_selected_by_evidence.gated_on: GPU. 30B does not fit the CPU path this chain used, and the HCLI resident holds the device.
